Question: Consider the set of all fractions \(\dfrac{x}{y},\) where \(x\) and \(y\) are relatively prime positive integers. How many of these fractions have the property that if both numerator and denominator are increased by \(1,\) the value of the fraction is increased by \(10\%?\)
